author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam meets up with Project Hail Mary author Andy Weir during the production of the movie! They visit the film's model shop to take Andy's first look at the Beetles probe ship props, and then Adam tours the props department  and mold shop to learn how almost every prop that has to fill the Hail Mary spaceship set is created in house. 

Watch Project Hail Mary today: https://www.amazon.com/Project-Hail-Mary-Phil-Lord/dp/B0GHXTWRV2
